name: Annoying Robots
author: Shimon Ulewicz
description: Race your robots across the board before your rival: big robots climb onto small ones and jumps chain like in checkers. Vs AI or 2 players. Arrows and Z to play.

descriptions.en: Race your robots across the board before your rival: big robots climb onto small ones and jumps chain like in checkers. Vs AI or 2 players. Arrows and Z to play.
descriptions.it: Porta i tuoi robot dall'altra parte del tabellone prima del rivale: i grandi salgono sui piccoli e i salti si concatenano come a dama. Contro la CPU o in due. Frecce e Z.
